provenance.registry_note: MODELED: last PMMS print carried forward by the 10Y move since that print, beta 0.95. PMMS is a weekly Thursday survey; this is the daily read between prints.

derivation.note: PMMS is weekly. This carries the last print forward on the 10Y move so there is a daily read between Thursdays. The 0.95 beta is the historical pass-through of a 10Y move into the mortgage rate.

move.detail: +3 bp. Bigger in magnitude than 40% of the 2693 moves since 2016-01-08. The typical move is 4.7 bp; this is 0.4 sigma. Not even the largest in your own window: +14 bp on 2026-10-01 was bigger.

insights.stat_line: Sitting in the top of its 1-year range, at the 99th percentile.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.
impact.no_chain_note: This series is not a node in the causal graph. It is context, not a modeled driver of mortgage rates.
